outcome_evidence: The robot approaches the upper drawer and aligns its gripper with the handle (frames 20–79, left_ego_image and wrist_image), then pulls the drawer outward (frames 88–106, image and left_ego_image). The extended drawer and exposed interior are visible by frame 106 in image. The robot releases the handle and withdraws (frames 120–171, wrist_image and image), leaving the drawer open through frame 177. No failed acquisition or robot-caused side effect is visibly established.
